description: JSON schema for a Synapse Portal.

id.description: The unique ID issued for this Portal. Generated by Synapse

name.description: The name of the portal, must be unique.

url.description: The base URL of the portal, must be unique.

createdBy.description: The ID of the user that created the portal.

createdOn.description: The date time this Portal was first created

modifiedBy.description: The ID of the user that updated the portal.

modifiedOn.description: The date time this POrtal was last updated.
